At Gina Tricot, speed is the signature. Bringing the latest fashion trends to 140 stores across Europe on the exact same day requires more than just great logistics, it requires flawless in-store execution.

To deliver a truly seamless shopping experience, their teams need to know exactly what inventory they have the moment a delivery arrives. 
By eliminating time-consuming manual box counts, store associates are spending less time in the back room and more time out on the floor doing what they do best: helping customers find the perfect fit and keeping checkout lines short.


With the help of our partner Sitoo, self-checkout stations were introduced and Zebra RFID readers pick up every tag, making the shopping experience smooth and seamless.

We're proud to provide the technology working quietly behind the scenes that helps Gina Tricot turn inventory visibility into an exceptional shopper experience!

It is with profound sadness that we share the news of the passing of Rob Armstrong, our Chief Marketing Officer. 
 
For nearly 22 years at Zebra, Rob was a trusted colleague, a thoughtful leader, and a mentor to so many, touching the lives of our employees, customers, and partners alike. He challenged us to think bigger, stay curious, and approach our work with an outside-in perspective grounded in insight, creativity, and a deep understanding of our customers. He truly believed in the power of people and relationships, helping to build a culture rooted in respect, collaboration, and continuous learning. 
 
Rob’s leadership was instrumental in elevating the impact of the Marketing team across our business. Beyond his work at Zebra, Rob was deeply committed to giving back to the community, serving on the boards of Bernie's Book Bank and the Illinois Chapter of FIRST Robotics. 
 
Our sincere condolences go out to his family and loved ones during this incredibly difficult time. Rob will be sincerely missed by all who had the privilege of knowing and working with him.

posts.content:
Distracted driving isn't just a highway problem. It’s a warehouse, rail yard, and tarmac problem, too.

April is Distracted Driving Awareness Month, which perfectly coincides with the 10th anniversary of our PartnerConnect program. There is no better time to highlight why our partners are so critical to solving tough challenges for our customers.

In a recent Zebra Podcast, Wes Coleman sat down with Ted Chen, Co-Founder of LifeSaver Mobile, to talk about the science behind screen distraction. Relying on an employee's willpower to ignore a buzzing phone just doesn't work. Our brains are wired to check those notifications.

The solution? Proactive safety. By combining Zebra’s hardware with LifeSaver Mobile’s software, we automatically restrict screen access while a vehicle or forklift is in motion. Once they stop, full access returns instantly, removing the temptation entirely, and keeping your frontline safe without disrupting their workflow.
